caption:
Whale shark season is closing out on the Sea of Cortez.

From The Moroccan Palace in El Sargento, La Paz is a short drive — and that's where you board the boats that bring you face-to-face with the largest fish in the ocean. Gentle, 30-foot filter feeders that glide through the bay this time of year before heading back out to sea.

Stay with Scott and Jewels in the Moroccan-inspired villa: 22-foot pool, rooftop sky bed, three glamping tents. Mornings swimming with whale sharks. Afternoons at the pool. Evenings watching the sun set over the Sea of Cortez.

Open dates in May before the season ends. DM to book or visit themoroccanpalace.com.
